Synthetic TLS fixtures for local loopback tests only. Never use these keys or
trust this CA outside tests. No personal certificate, domain or key is included.

The ECDSA P-256 CA and server certificate were generated with OpenSSL for the
reserved DNS name chat.example. Certificates expire in September 2036. The CA
signing key was discarded; the unencrypted DER server private key is deliberately
public test material. Tests install the CA only in an explicitly configured
test client and replace DNS resolution only inside cfg(test).

The federation-* Ed25519 fixtures use a separate test CA for chat.example and
federated.example. The two-server acceptance runs with isolated container DNS.
